extra.summary: The Citi Cash Back+ Card stands out with its straightforward 1.6% cashback on all eligible spending, appealing to those who dislike tracking categories or minimum spends. Cashback doesn't expire, providing long-term value. It’s especially good if you want a fuss-free experience. Though it lacks category-specific bonuses, this card offers simplicity and predictability for everyday spending.

annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Minimum Monthly Repayment: 1% of the current balance plus 1% of any outstanding unbilled instalment amounts plus interest charges plus late payment charge or S$50, whichever is greater

our_takes.our-take: The Citi Cash Back+ Card stands out with its straightforward 1.6% cashback on all eligible spending, appealing to those who dislike tracking categories or minimum spends. Cashback doesn't expire, providing long-term value. It’s especially good if you want a fuss-free experience. Though it lacks category-specific bonuses, this card offers simplicity and predictability for everyday spending. The 3.25% foreign transaction fee is something to consider for overseas spending.
our_takes.good-for:
Those seeking fuss-free cashback on all purchases, without tracking categories or minimum spends easily benefit.
Cardholders who need cashback on big-ticket purchases like furniture or electronics, thanks to the uncapped rewards.
Citi Plus account holders looking to boost cashback earnings on everyday spending, such as groceries and transportation costs.
our_takes.things-to-note:
$196.20 annual fee applies after the first year; consider if the cashback earned justifies the cost.
Late payment fees of $100 can negate cashback earnings, so always pay on time.
Cash advance fees are high at 8% or $15, so avoid using this card for cash withdrawals.
